evidence: We are Main Tap Tavern, a local bar in EC dedicated to great craft beer and fun nights out.
Open daily from 4 PM to 2 AM Thursday through Sunday, closed Monday through Wednesday.

We create world-class experiences through restaurants, nightclubs, and hotels in cities like Los Angeles, Las Vegas, San Diego, and beyond.
